question: What explains the decline in Goldman Sachs's net revenues in fiscal 2023?
gold_answer: Net revenues were $46.25 billion in 2023, 2% lower than 2022, reflecting lower net revenues in Global Banking & Markets (lower FICC net revenues and lower investment banking fees, compared with a strong prior year), largely offset by higher net revenues in Platform Solutions (consumer platforms) and Asset & Wealth Management (management and other fees) (Item 7, MD&A).

question: Why did Pfizer's revenues fall so sharply in fiscal 2023?

Excluding Comirnaty and Paxlovid, revenues rose 7% operationally (Item 7, MD&A).
